documents.name: HR Policy
documents.text: HR Policy Document. Employees are entitled to 20 days of sick leave per year. All leave requests require manager approval. Maternity leave is 4 months with full pay. Paternity leave is 2 weeks. Annual bonuses are approved based on performance reviews. Health insurance covers employees and immediate family. Access to company facilities requires HR approval. Expense reimbursement for approved business travel is processed within 5 working days.

documents.name: IT Policy
documents.text: IT Policy Document. Laptop reimbursement limit is $2000 USD. All equipment must be approved by IT manager before purchase. Access to company servers requires security clearance. Remote work access is approved on a per-employee basis. Software licenses must be approved through IT. Cybersecurity training is mandatory annually. Equipment replacement happens every 3 years. Access revocation takes 24 hours. Reimbursement for approved software is processed within 10 days.

documents.name: Finance Policy
documents.text: Finance Policy Document. All expenses above $500 require approval from finance manager. Reimbursement requests must include receipts. Monthly expense reports are due by the 5th. Travel expenses are reimbursed at standard rates. Meal expenses are capped at $50 per day. Policy violation can result in reimbursement denial. Approval process takes 3-5 business days. Advance approval is required for expenses over $2000. Petty cash is limited to $200 per month.
